name: Bantam Tools Desktop CNC Milling Machine
notes: Still listed on bantamtools.com at USD 6,999 (CE International Edition USD 7,999) but both are sold out and cannot be ordered; ToolGuyd reported in Nov 2025 that Bantam Tools no longer sells CNC mills (no official statement). Stage set to discontinued on that basis; price is the last listed price. Dry milling only (no coolant). Conductive auto-probing in the Bantam software (automatic tool touch-off for tool length, stock location/thickness on conductive stock via the included probing pin). Feed = max traverse. 4th axis compatible (4th axis accessory no longer listed). Made in Peekskill, NY; ships fully assembled.

accessories.name: Bantam Tools Desktop CNC Fixturing Pallet (Alternative)
accessories.description: 11 x 9 x 0.75 in conductive fixturing plate with threaded pin holes that expands the work area (alternative version: logo in a different corner, one non-functioning mounting point).

accessories.name: Bantam Tools Desktop CNC Basic Vise
accessories.description: Aluminium vise for the T-slot bed or fixturing pallet, compatible with the software's automated probing routines.
